body.name: \beta_{\mathrm{KM}}
body.construction: For each cell, define the marginal Kaplan--Meier limit directly by \[\widetilde S_c(t)=\prod_{u\le t}\left\{1-\frac{P_c(U_{ci}=u,\Delta_{ci}=1)}{P_c(U_{ci}\ge u)}\right\}\] in discrete time, with the corresponding product integral in general. Extract \(\widetilde y,\widetilde M,\widetilde B\) from these pseudo-limit curves and set \[\beta_{\mathrm{KM}}=\widetilde y(\widetilde M)_r^+\widetilde B-yM_r^+B.\]
